video_title: The REAL problem with Jaylen Brown and should he just shut up and fall in line 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Celtics' decision to trade Jaylen Brown is questionable
quotes.excerpt: How are y'all talking about trading me because my value is high? Maybe that's the only thing I can think of.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Jaylen Brown, Boston Celtics. They showed their hand. I said this before, the year they won it, he was the best player offensively and defensively. Now you are telling me we come back, we are cooking again, Jayson Tatum goes out, you have us as one of the worst teams in the NBA with their second seed team. How are y'all talking about trading me because my value is high? Maybe that's the only thing I can think of.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: He is trading himself though, Pat.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: No such thing. Because he made the statement, this was the best year.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's comments about his best season were likely calculated
quotes.excerpt: Everything that he is doing right now is very calculated. I guarantee you it is very calculated.
quotes.quote: As hoopers, I think we have to understand that we do not know how he really meant it. In his mind, it could have been like, it is one of my favorite years of everyone doubted us and we came out on top. Everything that he is doing right now is very calculated. I guarantee you it is very calculated. I think he wants out. I think he wants his own team.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's controversial public persona could be a business risk
quotes.excerpt: He is very controversial, anti-Nike, anti-this. You could fuck up the money.
quotes.quote: You know this is the league. Now I am going to put my business hat on. He is very controversial, anti-Nike, anti-this. You could fuck up the money. Jalen, you are not going to get no headaches from Jalen. We know this league is not about basketball sometimes. It is about the other shit.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: There is no valid reason to criticize Jaylen Brown's off-court behavior
quotes.excerpt: What has he done wrong off the court, on the court, to validate any negative anything about Jaylen Brown?
quotes.quote: What has he done wrong off the court, on the court, to validate any negative anything about Jaylen Brown? We see him traveling, we see him in seems like healthy relationships, we see him working out, we see him healthy, we see him producing. We see him producing so much that he has to speak up for himself like, damn, why am I not in the MVP racing?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's activism during the bubble changed his public perception
quotes.excerpt: When he was front line when the Black Lives Matter, and when the NBA was with the Black Lives Matter too.
quotes.quote: When he was front line when the Black Lives Matter, and when the NBA was with the Black Lives Matter too, we were in the bubble, everybody had different names on their jersey. When he spoke up about that, in my mind, I think everything changed slowly. Very slowly. I think that bled into shoe deals, I think that bled into how people view him.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown needs a team where he is the primary option
quotes.excerpt: He needs the ball. When I say need the rock, he don't need the rock to bring it up.
quotes.quote: He needs the ball. When I say need the rock, he don't need the rock to bring it up. He just give him the ball and he can do his thing, more freedom. If I am the GM, I am picking him. I am keeping him. Get off the De'Aaron Fox contract, give him some picks, give him one of them young guys, Jaylen Brown. It fits.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Celtics prioritize assets over Jaylen Brown's personal desires
quotes.excerpt: I don't think the Celtics give a fuck about what Jaylen Brown wants. They are going to get the return.
quotes.quote: I don't think the Celtics give a fuck about what Jaylen Brown wants. They are going to get the return for what they are getting. Clearly they don't care. His ass might end up in Charlotte then, you are right.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Trading Jaylen Brown to the Charlotte Hornets makes no sense
quotes.excerpt: If I am Boston, that don't make sense to me. I wouldn't do it if I am Boston.
quotes.quote: If I am Boston, that don't make sense to me. I wouldn't do it if I am Boston. I would take that Portland deal before that, Drew and Denny. I don't think they should trade him. I don't trade him, man.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown has never been a locker room cancer
quotes.excerpt: He is never went at his teammates or the team. He is always went at the media.
quotes.quote: He is never went at his teammates or the team. He is always went at the media. He is always went about how things is unfair. In the media, he always went he just never we have never heard him talk anything bad about his teammates not one time. So we cannot even paint him to be just this cancer in the locker room, because that is not even the case.
